36.otsikko: Kickoff, toolchain and the first deploy

tehtavat.teksti: Hold the kickoff talk and record every answer
tehtavat.valmis: Every question in the kickoff notes has an answer marked decision, open item or assumption, and the must-have scope (P0) is agreed.
tehtavat.tallenna: The kickoff notes with the question list in `project-docs/`. The open questions and their answers go into the week 36 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Set up the tools and the public repository
tehtavat.valmis: `index.html` opens through http://localhost, the public repository has a README, the privacy check is done and 2FA is on.
tehtavat.tallenna: The repository link and the first commit hash go into the week 36 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Publish the empty site over your phone's hotspot
tehtavat.valmis: The public URL opens on your phone and on a device that has never seen the project, and the DevTools console shows no red errors.
tehtavat.tallenna: The phone screenshot in `project-docs/evidence/week-36/`. The network notes and the screenshot link go into the week 36 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Draft the plan and turn the P0 pages into GitHub issues
tehtavat.valmis: The plan draft is committed, and every must-have page (P0) has an issue with a done-when condition and a size estimate.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/technical-plan.md` committed and the issues in the repository. The issue numbers go into the week 36 journal entry.

36.nayta: Kickoff notes with the question list, the repository with its README, the first deploy live at the public URL, the plan draft, the P0 backlog — and the phone screenshot in project-docs/evidence/week-36/.
36.tuotos: Kickoff notes with a question list, a public repository with a privacy check done, the site folder served by a local web server on your computer, the first deploy published over your phone hotspot and live at the public URL, the technical plan drafted and the P0 backlog — the ordered list of what is still to do — as issues.
36.valmis: The public URL opens on a device that has never seen the project, and another person understands from the README and the plan what is being built and for whom.
36.label: 31 Aug – 4 Sep

37.otsikko: Content becomes data: the Alphabet view

tehtavat.teksti: Justify the data store and type the first data from your PDF
tehtavat.valmis: `data/letters.json` and the first ten records of `data/words.json` are typed from the PDF, and the plan justifies the agreed data store against at least one alternative.
tehtavat.tallenna: The JSON files committed in `data/` and the justification in `project-docs/technical-plan.md`. The PDF pages you typed go into the week 37 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Build the shared loader and the Alphabet page
tehtavat.valmis: The Alphabet & Pronunciation page renders from `data/letters.json` at the public URL, and a renamed file shows your error message instead of a blank page.
tehtavat.tallenna: `js/data.js` and the Alphabet page committed and deployed. The commit links go into the week 37 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Check the data and prove the check catches an error
tehtavat.valmis: `tools/check-data.html` reports "content OK", reports an error when you break one line, and the alphabet table matches the PDF.
tehtavat.tallenna: `tools/check-data.html` committed. What the check caught and its pass/fail report go into the week 37 journal entry.

37.nayta: data/letters.json and data/words.json, js/data.js, the Alphabet page live at the public URL, and the tools/check-data.html report pass/fail in the journal.
37.tuotos: data/letters.json and the first records of data/words.json typed from the PDF (pages 7, 9–11, 12 and 41), the agreed data store justified in the plan against at least one alternative, js/data.js as the one loader every page uses, the Alphabet & Pronunciation page live with real loading and error states, and tools/check-data.html reporting on every data file.
37.valmis: The public URL shows the alphabet table rendered from data/letters.json, and tools/check-data.html reports "content OK" — and reports an error when you deliberately break one line.
37.label: 7–11 Sep

38.otsikko: Bootstrap shell and the component decision

tehtavat.teksti: Write the component-library comparison memo
tehtavat.valmis: `project-docs/library-comparison.md` covers all three options with your own before-numbers and the supervisor's view, and the plan names your components.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/library-comparison.md` committed and the decision on the Plan page. The three options and the decision go into the week 38 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Take Bootstrap into use and build the shared shell
tehtavat.valmis: Bootstrap loads from the CDN with a pinned version, the navbar works from every page and collapses on a phone, and Home shows the credit and the terms.
tehtavat.tallenna: The pages and `css/style.css` committed and deployed. Which components you use and where you wrote your own CSS go into the week 38 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Measure again and record the before/after numbers
tehtavat.valmis: The memo has the before and after numbers side by side and at least one named limit.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/library-comparison.md` with the before/after pair, committed. Your measurements go into the week 38 journal entry.

38.nayta: The comparison memo with your own measured numbers is in project-docs/, the navbar works from every page on the public URL and collapses correctly on a phone, and the Home page shows the credit and terms.
38.tuotos: A comparison memo of Bootstrap against one other component library and the no-library option — with your own measurements (transferred KB from the DevTools Network panel, Lighthouse scores) — Bootstrap loaded from the CDN with a pinned version, a theme configured by overriding its CSS variables in css/style.css, the navbar and the grid on every page, and the Home page with the classification, the credit and the terms of use.
38.valmis: The comparison memo with your own measured numbers is in project-docs/, the navbar works from every page on the public URL and collapses correctly on a phone, and the Home page shows the credit and terms.
38.label: 14–18 Sep

tehtavat.teksti: Design the pronoun data and type it from the PDF
tehtavat.valmis: `data/grammar.json` has eight pronoun sets in the same shape, and `tools/check-data.html` passes.
tehtavat.tallenna: `data/grammar.json` committed. The shape and the PDF pages you typed go into the week 39 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Write renderTable() and wire the eight tables into tabs
tehtavat.valmis: All eight pronoun tables render at the public URL through one renderTable(), the tabs work with the keyboard, and wide tables scroll on a phone.
tehtavat.tallenna: `js/render.js` and the Pronouns page committed. How renderTable() stays generic goes into the week 39 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Prove the loading and error states with screenshots
tehtavat.valmis: Both screenshots show your own states, and the phone check passes.
tehtavat.tallenna: The screenshots in `project-docs/evidence/week-39/`, linked in the week 39 journal entry.

39.nayta: All eight pronoun tables render on the public URL from data/grammar.json, the tabs can be operated with the keyboard alone, wide tables scroll horizontally on a phone, and renaming the JSON shows your error state.
39.tuotos: The pronouns section of data/grammar.json (eight datasets typed from PDF pages 13–18 and 22–26), a reusable renderTable() in js/render.js that builds a Bootstrap table, Bootstrap tabs between pronoun types, working loading/error states, and horizontal scrolling for wide tables on a phone.
39.valmis: All eight pronoun tables render on the public URL from data/grammar.json, the tabs can be operated with the keyboard alone, wide tables scroll horizontally on a phone instead of breaking the layout, and renaming the JSON shows your error state.
39.label: 21–25 Sep

40.otsikko: Nouns, articles and gender — and v0.5

tehtavat.teksti: Model the gender-by-number data and type it from the PDF
tehtavat.valmis: The nouns and articles sections in `data/grammar.json` match PDF pages 8 and 19–21, and `tools/check-data.html` passes.
tehtavat.tallenna: `data/grammar.json` committed. How the gender × number shape drove the data design goes into the week 40 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Build the Nouns & Articles page with an accordion
tehtavat.valmis: The Nouns & Articles page renders every matrix through renderTable() at the public URL, and the accordion works with the keyboard alone.
tehtavat.tallenna: The page committed and deployed. Why the accordion earns its place on a long page goes into the week 40 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Tag v0.5 and deploy it
tehtavat.valmis: The v0.5 tag is on GitHub and the deployed site matches it.
tehtavat.tallenna: The tag in the repository. The tag and what you left for the review to judge go into the week 40 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Book the week-44 review in writing
tehtavat.valmis: `project-docs/review-agreement.md` is committed with the roles, the date, the place and the three tasks.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/review-agreement.md` committed. The booked review details go into the week 40 journal entry.

40.nayta: The four grammar pages render correctly on the public URL, the accordion opens and closes with the keyboard alone, v0.5 is tagged, and the review agreement (roles + date) is committed in project-docs/.
40.tuotos: The nouns and articles sections added to data/grammar.json from the PDF, the gender×number matrices rendered by the week-39 function, the rule sections wrapped in a Bootstrap accordion built from the same data, example sentences from the PDF, the v0.5 git tag, and a written agreement of the review: the client's representative and the tester by role, the date and the place for week 44.
40.valmis: The four grammar pages render correctly on the public URL, the accordion opens and closes with the keyboard alone, v0.5 is tagged, and the review agreement (roles + date) is committed in project-docs/.
40.label: 28 Sep – 2 Oct

tehtavat.teksti: Run the review and record the findings verbatim
tehtavat.valmis: `project-docs/review-2026-w44.md` separates the tester's words from your interpretation, and every finding has a decision.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/review-2026-w44.md` committed. The three most surprising findings in the tester's words, with the tester's role and the date, go into the week 44 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Turn the decisions into issues and re-plan the backlog
tehtavat.valmis: Every accepted finding is an issue with a done-when condition, the backlog is re-prioritised, and the estimate-versus-actual difference is written down.
tehtavat.tallenna: The issues in the repository. What you re-prioritised and why, and the estimate comparison, go into the week 44 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Fix a small batch and write debugging chain 1/3
tehtavat.valmis: Chain 1/3 in `project-docs/debugging-chains.md` runs from the tester's words to a regression test, with the fix commit linked.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/debugging-chains.md` and the regression test row in `project-docs/test-matrix.md`, committed. The chain links go into the week 44 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Check the device-security open item with the supervisor
tehtavat.valmis: The plan's device-security item shows the supervisor's answer or is still marked open, and the plan is committed.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/technical-plan.md` committed. The answer, or that it is still open, goes into the week 44 journal entry.

44.nayta: project-docs/review-2026-w44.md with the two voices separated, the updated backlog, the fix commits, and chain 1 in debugging-chains.md.
44.tuotos: A review log with the tester's findings verbatim and your interpretation separately, the client's decisions on each finding, an updated P0/P1/P2 backlog with new issues, a small fix batch deployed, and debugging chain 1/3 (observation → reproduction → cause → fix commit → re-test → regression test). The t12 open item is checked with the supervisor.
44.valmis: The review log is committed with the two voices clearly separated, every finding has a decision (fix / won't fix / P2), and chain 1/3 is complete from a real finding, with its regression test in the matrix.
44.label: 26–30 Oct

45.otsikko: The number converter — built from scratch

tehtavat.teksti: Write the converter tests first, from the PDF
tehtavat.valmis: `tests/numbers.test.js` has at least 6 converter tests whose names cite PDF pages, and a commit shows them all red before the implementation.
tehtavat.tallenna: The all-red commit and `tests/numbers.test.js`. The test-first evidence goes into the week 45 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Implement the converter as small pure functions
tehtavat.valmis: `tests/tests.html` reports 0 failed, and `js/numbers.js` contains no DOM or fetch code.
tehtavat.tallenna: `js/numbers.js` and `data/numbers.json`, committed test by test. The function breakdown and the two hardest rules go into the week 45 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Build the converter UI by hand and ship the feedback change
tehtavat.valmis: On the public URL at least 0–999 999 converts correctly, junk input gets a clear message, and the feedback change is live and linked to its finding.
tehtavat.tallenna: The Numbers page and the merge commit. The feedback-change link goes into the week 45 journal entry.

45.nayta: tests/numbers.test.js with PDF-cited expectations, js/numbers.js, the Numbers page live, and the feedback-change commit linked to its finding.
45.tuotos: data/numbers.json (cardinals, ordinals, the paragoge/apocope rules as data where possible), js/numbers.js with pure functions and no DOM code, tests/tests.html with a small test runner you wrote yourself and expected values taken from the PDF before running, the converter UI built from scratch, the comparison section, and the week-44 feedback change deployed and linked to its finding. Debugging chain 2/3 starts from any real bug found here or in week 46.
45.valmis: On the public URL, at least 0–999 999 converts correctly including the separation and clipping rules, tests/tests.html reports 0 failed with at least 6 converter tests whose names cite PDF pages, and the feedback change is live.
45.label: 2–6 Nov

tehtavat.teksti: Finish the word and phrase data from the PDF
tehtavat.valmis: Both files match the PDF, pages 57–58 say "coming later", and `tools/check-data.html` passes.
tehtavat.tallenna: `data/words.json` and `data/phrases.json` committed. The "coming later" decision goes into the week 46 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Build the word cards and the dialogue viewer
tehtavat.valmis: On the public URL the cards drop to one column on a phone, and the dialogue switches between Ionian and English.
tehtavat.tallenna: The Phrasebook page committed and deployed, linked in the week 46 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Build the search and prove it cannot be tricked
tehtavat.valmis: Typing "thank" finds the "thank you" card with a live match count, and the attack string renders as harmless text.
tehtavat.tallenna: The screenshot in `project-docs/evidence/week-46/`. How the filter works and why textContent is safe go into the week 46 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Plan the whole test matrix and commit the licence files
tehtavat.valmis: The test matrix has at least 12 cases with the expected results filled in, LICENSE and CREDITS are committed, and chain 2/3 is written up.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/test-matrix.md`, `LICENSE` and `CREDITS` committed. The state of chain 2/3 goes into the week 46 journal entry.

46.nayta: The Phrasebook live with the card grid and search, the XSS screenshot, the full test matrix with expected results filled in, and the LICENSE/CREDITS commits.
46.tuotos: data/words.json completed and data/phrases.json written (basic vocabulary p. 12, greetings and dialogues pp. 51–56), the vocabulary rendered as a responsive Bootstrap card grid, the dialogue viewer with the toggle, a search box that filters in memory and renders with textContent, the remaining test matrix planned (including the broken-network case), the LICENSE file with the licence agreed with the supervisor and the CREDITS file, and debugging chain 2/3 completed if it started in week 45 or started from a real bug this week.

tehtavat.valmis: Every row has an observed result and a date, the failures are marked, and both test pages are green on main.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/test-matrix.md` committed. The failures the matrix caught go into the week 47 journal entry.

tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/debugging-chains.md` committed. The chain 3/3 links go into the week 47 journal entry.

tehtavat.valmis: Every page has a Lighthouse before/after pair and passes the W3C HTML validator without errors.
tehtavat.tallenna: `project-docs/lighthouse/` and `project-docs/html-validation.md` committed. The Lighthouse pairs and what the validator found go into the week 47 journal entry.

tehtavat.valmis: The fresh clone runs with the README steps only.
tehtavat.tallenna: The clean-clone notes and the README fix commits. The clean-environment result goes into the week 48 journal entry.

tehtavat.teksti: Run the user test with one written task
tehtavat.valmis: The tester reached and read the café dialogue using only the site and your written instructions, and every hesitation has a fix.
